Hi @{author}. Thanks for taking the time to contribute to Workers SDK.

This PR has been automatically closed because you are not currently a registered (vouched) collaborator for this repository.

AI tools now let our team generate proposed code changes quickly. Reviewing changes, checking that they solve the right problem, and maintaining code quality over time still take substantial care and effort. We therefore limit PRs to registered collaborators so we can focus that effort where it is most useful.

For most external contributors, the most effective way to help is through [issues](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/issues): describing a problem or use case, providing a minimal reproduction, investigating its cause, or helping us verify a fix. Those contributions help us understand what needs to change and are very welcome.

We will take an initial look at this PR and decide whether it is something we want to invest in reviewing and maintaining. We may reopen it if we decide to proceed, but we cannot guarantee that it will be reopened or receive a full review.
